selection: New open native evaluator change, selected from title before reading its body, source or reviews; existing native evaluator environment and regression experience reduce integration work. Other search hits not investigated.
question: Does the proposed async-environment compatibility change preserve the native synchronous evaluator contract across episode boundaries, seeds and action-dependent observations?
design: Read exact base and head, existing reviews and tests; credit known upstream diagnosis and do not duplicate its fix.
Run unchanged existing relevant tests as the conventional automated-test comparator. This is not the strongest engineer/agent workflow.
Before executing new controls, freeze deterministic source-bound obligations and their expected behavior from native synchronous reference and Gym semantics.

Use native SyncVectorEnv and AsyncVectorEnv with spawn, simple deterministic action-dependent Gym fixtures, scripted CPU policy and real pipelines; no learned policy, physics, GPU, reserved robot conditions or private owner data.

Exercise deterministic task completion, success accounting across unequal episode lengths, exact executed action sequence and reset/repeated-episode behavior with supplied seeds. Scope details may be adapted to supported upstream interfaces before execution and recorded.
Run both relevant original base and proposed head, plus any narrowly justified correction; retain all failures and timing. Refuse unrelated import/collection failures as scientific results.
stop_rule: One public change; four hours maximum inspection/engineering; stop on no supported native comparison or no decision-relevant gap. No platform expansion or new intake requests.
claims_allowed: Source-bound native software conformance or specific regression on executed controls.
Incremental automated test coverage against the unchanged upstream selected tests.
Observed reuse/integration cost, with unmeasured human/API costs explicit.
claims_excluded: General diagnostic advantage or independent heldout benchmark.
Matched-quality economic superiority over the strongest conventional engineer/agent workflow.
Customer acceptance, GPU/learned-policy/hardware safety or physical task success.
cost_recording: UTC wall timestamps, command runtimes, environment/package/source identity, failed attempts and tests retained; engineering elapsed is a session proxy, not human labor.
